crystal_phase.PtCo: face center cubic (fcc) PtCo alloy phase

Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern of PtCo CNCs and Pt NPs (Fig. 1b) demonstrated the formation of face center cubic (fcc) PtCo alloy phase. The angles of the facets of a PtCo CNC projected along the [001] direction signified by selected area electron diffraction (SAED) (Fig. S4a, inset) were determined to be approximately 18.4°, 14.0° and 11.3°, in consistent with {310}, {410} and {510} high-index facets of Pt, respectively.
